𝗦𝗟 𝗟𝗘𝗔𝗗 𝗕𝗬 𝟴𝟮, 𝟭 𝗪𝗜𝗖𝗞𝗘𝗧 𝗟𝗘𝗙𝗧! 🇱🇰

Sri Lanka are 309/9 at Day 3 stumps in Rawalpindi, after being bowled out for 98.
Pakistan made 325; Kusal Mendis scored 53.

Who wins it on Day 4? 👇
